title: Three Seasons and One Short Net
subtitle: 江河湖海 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）
meta: 主题语境：江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）　|　核心词汇：strait　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 strait 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 the fisherman ① crossed the strait that no boatman in the harbour would have counted, and he said the crossing was the whole of the season. The ② strait, meaning the channel itself and not the net, ran three seasons and stayed uncounted in the book; a strait, he said, is the only thing in a harbour that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ strait in that harbour had the same short net beside it, and the ④ strait at the far pier, meaning the catch they kept for the children to land and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A strait, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the fisherman said the counting is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the strait was the whole of the matter, meaning the passage and not the channel. The ⑥ strait, meaning the passage and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; strait, he said, is either something you cross or the only word that means both a channel and a passage. He said the passage is the part they remember.

By 1968 the ⑦ strait had become a line in a logbook, and the logbook had become an argument about the short net. The ⑧ strait of the whole thing, the fisherman wrote in July, was one harbour and three seasons of counting; strait, he said, is either the catch at the far pier or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ strait I remember is the channel counted in the logbook, which closed in 1970 and is still counted as the quietest in the harbour. A ⑩ strait, my mother said in 1972, is the only channel that improves by being counted; every strait, she said, is a passage that has agreed to look like a channel. She said the passage was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 海峡（指渔港里每一道旁边的那一道）
B. n. 海峡（指那道海峡本身，与小小的渔网相对）
C. 固定搭配：cross the strait 穿越这一道海峡
D. n. 海峡（指留给孩子们起的那一网）
E. n. 海峡之事（抽象总称，指一处渔港的海峡之事）
F. n. 海峡（指航海日志里写到、被清点的那一道）
G. n. 海峡、通道（指一件事里人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 通道（抽象总称，指人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: crossed the strait that no boatman in the harbour would have counted
The strait, meaning the channel itself and not the net
the strait at the far pier
the strait was the whole of the matter
the strait had become a line in a logbook
The strait of the whole thing
A strait, my mother said in 1972

answers.why: cross the strait 意为“穿越这一道海峡”，1963 年那位渔人把渔港里没有一位船工肯清点的一道海峡做了一遍。
strait 意为“海峡”，指那道海峡本身而不是小小的渔网，它经过了三个汛期而在簿子上没有被清点。
strait 意为“海峡”，指渔港里每一道旁边的那一道，每一道旁边都有同一张小小的渔网。
strait 意为“海峡”，指最远那座码头的留给孩子们起的那一网，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
strait 意为“海峡、通道”，指一件事里人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这道通道就是那件事的全部。
strait 意为“通道”，指人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西而不是那道海峡，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
strait 意为“海峡”，指航海日志里写到、被清点的那一道，到 1968 年这一道成了航海日志里的一行。
strait 意为“海峡之事”，渔人七月写道，整件事的海峡之事是一处渔港和三个汛期的清点。
strait 意为“海峡”，我记得的是航海日志里清点过的那一道，1970 年归港了，至今仍被说成渔港里最安静的一道。
strait 为抽象总称，母亲 1972 年说，海峡是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的海峡。

task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1963 年那位渔人穿越了渔港里没有一位船工肯清点的一道海峡，他说这一遍才是那个汛期的全部。（cross the strait）
那道海峡，指的是那道海峡本身而不是小小的渔网，经过了三个汛期而在簿子上没有被清点。（strait）
那处渔港里每一道海峡旁边都有同一张小小的渔网。（strait）
最远那座码头那道海峡，指的是他们留给孩子们起的那一网，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（strait）
叔叔说这道通道就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那道海峡。（strait）
